blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever um diário sobre o daoismo, usando paralelismo, o comparativo duplo (the more… the less…) e uma entonação serena.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Notes by the River
paras: I spent the weekend with the *Dao De Jing* and a thermos of tea. **The more** I tried to grasp its meaning, **the less** I seemed to hold. **That, I suspect, is the point.** “Water is soft, yet it wears away stone,” says the text; **softness overcomes hardness**, **stillness** overcomes **haste**.

Zhuangzi **dreamed he was a butterfly**, **and on waking could not say** whether he was a man who had dreamed or a butterfly now dreaming. **I envy** his **lightness**. Back at my desk, I tried **wu wei**, **acting without forcing**: I **stopped fighting** the email backlog and answered **only what was asked**. **To my surprise**, the day **flowed**. **Whether** that was wisdom or luck, **I cannot say**.

items.q: The writer found the meaning easy to grasp.
items.why: the less I seemed to hold.

items.q: Zhuangzi dreamed he was a butterfly.
The writer is sure that wu wei caused the good day.
items.why: wisdom or luck, I cannot say.

blocks.body: O **comparativo duplo** (*the more… the more/less…*) usa o comparativo nas duas partes, sem verbo auxiliar obrigatório. O **paralelismo** repete a estrutura para dar cadência; em voz alta, mantenha o mesmo contorno melódico nas duas partes.
Não escreva *The more I try, more I fail* ✗: o segundo trecho também precisa de *the* → *the more I fail* ✓.

items.s: ___ more I tried, the less I held. (the)
He could not say ___ he was a man or a butterfly. (whether)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Go with the flow.** — Seguir o fluxo.
**Let nature take its course.** — Deixar a natureza agir.
**Swim against the tide.** — Nadar contra a maré.
**Still waters run deep.** — Águas calmas são profundas.
**Bend with the wind.** — Curvar-se ao vento.
**Less is more.** — Menos é mais.
**Take it easy.** — Ir com calma.
**Ride the wave.** — Aproveitar a onda.
**Out of one’s depth.** — Fora de seu alcance.
**Peace of mind.** — Paz de espírito.
**Acting without forcing?** — Agir sem forçar?
**The more I chase calm, the less I find it.** — Quanto mais persigo a calma, menos a encontro.
**That may be the point of wu wei.** — Esse pode ser o ponto do wu wei.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence diary entry about letting go of effort, using the more… the less…, a parallel pair and Whether… or….
blocks.model: The more I rushed this morning, the later I became. So I stopped. Patience overcomes haste; quiet overcomes noise. Whether it was luck or design, the train waited. I arrived calm, and the day opened gently. I wonder what else I have been forcing.
